MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub android build [options]

Build and sign the APK into dist/android/ with a sidecar metadata JSON

Options:
  --server-url <url>  Default server URL baked into the app
  --debug             Build the debug variant (debug-signed, package
                      <id>.debug; not for publishing)
  -h, --help          display help for command
